title: The gap check runs on a clean merge or rebase on the roadmap branch
why: A clean merge or rebase on the roadmap branch runs no pre-commit hook, and the README's pull --rebase then amend flow re-checks only roadmap.html, so a duplicate step can land unchecked (lane gap gap-check-skips-merge-rebase).
